items.source: @DirtiesContext may be used as a class-level and method-level annotation within the same test class or test class hierarchy. In such scenarios, the ApplicationContext will be marked as dirty before or after any such annotated method as well as before or after the current test class, depending on the configured methodMode() and classMode(). When @DirtiesContext is declared at both the class level and the method level, the configured test phases from both annotations will be honored. For example, if the class mode is set to BEFORE_EACH_TEST_METHOD and the method mode is set to AFTER_METHOD, the context will be marked as dirty both before and after the given test method.
items.translation: @DirtiesContext 可作为类级别和方法级别的注解，用于同一测试类或测试类层次结构中。在此类场景中，根据配置的 methodMode() 和 classMode()，ApplicationContext 将在任何此类注解方法之前或之后，以及在当前测试类之前或之后被标记为 dirty。当 @DirtiesContext 同时在类级别和方法级别声明时，将同时遵循两个注解中配置的所有测试阶段。例如，如果类模式设置为 BEFORE_EACH_TEST_METHOD，而方法模式设置为 AFTER_METHOD，则上下文将在给定测试方法之前和之后均被标记为 dirty。

items.source: BEFORE_* modes are supported by the DirtiesContextBeforeModesTestExecutionListener; AFTER_* modes are supported by the DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener.
items.translation: BEFORE_* 模式由 DirtiesContextBeforeModesTestExecutionListener 支持；AFTER_* 模式由 DirtiesContextTestExecutionListener 支持。

items.source: Defaults to AFTER_METHOD.
items.translation: 默认为AFTER_METHOD。

items.source: Setting the method mode on an annotated test class has no meaning. For class-level control, use classMode() instead.
items.translation: 在已添加注解的测试类上设置方法模式没有意义。对于类级别的控制，请使用 classMode() 代替。

items.source: Defaults to AFTER_CLASS.
items.translation: 默认为AFTER_CLASS。

items.source: Setting the class mode on an annotated test method has no meaning. For method-level control, use methodMode() instead.
items.translation: 在已注解的测试方法上设置类模式没有意义。对于方法级别的控制，请使用methodMode()。

items.source: Defaults to EXHAUSTIVE.
items.translation: 默认为EXHAUSTIVE。

items.source:
Use this annotation if a test has modified the context — for
example, by modifying the state of a singleton bean, modifying the state
of an embedded database, etc. Subsequent tests that request the same context
will be supplied a new context.
items.translation: 如果测试修改了上下文（例如，修改了单例 Bean 的状态、嵌入式数据库的状态等），请使用此注解。随后请求相同上下文的测试将获得新的上下文。

items.source: The context cache clearing mode to use when a context is configured as part of a hierarchy via @ContextHierarchy.
items.translation: 用于在通过 `@ContextHierarchy` 将上下文配置为层次结构的一部分时清除上下文缓存的 模式。

items.source: Before current test class: when declared at the class level with class mode set to BEFORE_CLASS
items.translation: 在当前测试类之前：当在类级别声明并将类模式设置为 BEFORE_CLASS 时

items.source: Before each test method in current test class: when declared at the class level with class mode set to BEFORE_EACH_TEST_METHOD
items.translation: 当前测试类中的每个测试方法之前：当在类级别声明并将类模式设置为 BEFORE_EACH_TEST_METHOD 时

items.source: Before current test method: when declared at the method level with method mode set to BEFORE_METHOD
items.translation: 当前测试方法之前：当在方法级别声明并将方法模式设置为 BEFORE_METHOD 时。

items.source: After current test method: when declared at the method level with method mode set to AFTER_METHOD
items.translation: 当前测试方法之后：当在方法级别声明并将方法模式设置为 AFTER_METHOD 时。

items.source: After each test method in current test class: when declared at the class level with class mode set to AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD
items.translation: 当前测试类中的每个测试方法之后：当在类级别声明并将类模式设置为 AFTER_EACH_TEST_METHOD 时。

items.source: After current test class: when declared at the class level with class mode set to AFTER_CLASS
items.translation: 当前测试类之后：当在类级别声明并将类模式设置为 AFTER_CLASS 时。

items.source: Supported Test Phases
items.translation: 支持的测试阶段

items.source: This annotation may be used as a meta-annotation to create custom composed annotations.
items.translation: 此注解可用作 元注解 来创建自定义的 组合注解。

items.source: This annotation will be inherited from an enclosing test class by default. See @NestedTestConfiguration for details.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此注解将从外部测试类继承。有关详细信息，请参阅 @NestedTestConfiguration。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how the context cache is cleared when @DirtiesContext is used in a test whose context is configured as part of a hierarchy via @ContextHierarchy.
items.translation: 定义modes，以确定在使用@DirtiesContext时，当测试的上下文通过@ContextHierarchy配置为层次结构的一部分时，如何清除上下文缓存。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how @DirtiesContext is interpreted when used to annotate a test class.
items.translation: 定义modes，用于确定在用作测试类的注解时如何解释@DirtiesContext。

items.source: Defines modes which determine how @DirtiesContext is interpreted when used to annotate a test method.
items.translation: 定义modes，用于确定在用作测试方法的注解时如何解释@DirtiesContext。

items.source: The mode to use when a test class is annotated with @DirtiesContext.
items.translation: 当测试类被标注为 `@DirtiesContext` 时使用的mode。

items.source: The mode to use when a test method is annotated with @DirtiesContext.
items.translation: 当测试方法使用 @DirtiesContext 注解时，要使用的mode。
